capabilities: Center one note on a Poincaré disk of the vault
Place linked notes on a regular hyperbolic tiling by distance
Overlay the disk on the built-in Graph view and glide between notes
Reuse graph view colors, groups, link and node styles
Search, hover and click notes to re-center, with live settings
disambiguation: Not a standalone replacement for the graph view; it overlays a focused hyperbolic view on the built-in Graph view, which stays underneath.
extras: Works entirely offline with no telemetry; reads only note paths, resolved links, tags and .obsidian/graph.json, never note contents. Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; install from release files or BRAT until listed in Community plugins. Graph group queries support only path:, file:, tag:, - and OR.
intentEvidence: In Obsidian’s built-in Graph view, right-click a note and choose Open in Poincaré disk view
problem: In large vaults the built-in graph view draws every note with equal weight, so links tangle and the notes around the one you are working on get lost.
summary: Focus view that puts one note at the center of a Poincaré disk and lays out its linked neighborhood on a hyperbolic tiling.
